name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 5 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2025-05-01, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.62 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
